data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each take 10 tons this month, leave 50, and let it double back to 100. If we stick to that, everyone earns $10,000 a month without running down the lake our village depends on. Shall we agree to 10 tons each and review everyone’s catches together afterward? John, what do you think?
